tracks.name: Ratchet Rumbelow
tracks.vibe: Aggressive dark E-minor metal boss theme — galloping palm-mute bass, high-gain sawtooth lead with vibrato, pounding double-kick at 144 BPM, menacing carnival-underground energy.

tracks.name: Ferris Wheel Ascension
tracks.vibe: Euphoric trance, four-on-the-floor kick with rolling 16th hats, soaring square-wave lead over bright arpeggiated pads, A major with a big uplifting emotional lift.

tracks.name: Midnight Calliope
tracks.vibe: Mellow, groovy acid jazz/nu-jazz — warm Rhodes-like pads, syncopated swing, muted-brass lead over a steady walking bass, smooth mid-tempo night-carnival mood.

tracks.name: PYRA
tracks.vibe: Fast 150 BPM Egyptian punk-metal with NES chiptune flavor — heavy E minor riffing laced with phrygian-dominant and chromatic notes for an ancient, aggressive feel.

tracks.name: CARNIVAL NIGHT FIGHT
tracks.vibe: Fast E-phrygian-dominant punk-metal brawl at 168 BPM — ancient Egyptian half-step bite over bright fairground calliope layer, full driving drums, night mood.

tracks.name: Petal Panic Title v1 dream REMIX
tracks.vibe: Grand triumphant circus calliope fanfare in fast 8-bit chiptune — square-wave leads, punchy saw bass, fist-like drums — that curdles into uneasy whimsical horror as a tritone creeps in.

tracks.name: Brilliantly Stupid v1 REMIX
tracks.vibe: Slow, grand, ridiculous chiptune — a pompous villain fanfare played deadpan that cracks and collapses into half-time stupidity, not scary but absurd.

tracks.name: Brilliantly Stupid v3 REMIX
tracks.vibe: Slow, grand, ridiculous NES chiptune — a pompous villain parade fanfare played deadpan that cracks and collapses into half-time absurd defeat, not scary but stupid.

tracks.name: ACID METAL REMIX
tracks.vibe: E-minor techno-metal at 150 BPM, punchy sawtooth bass and square-wave lead, aggressive riffing with drums stacking from backbeat to busy 16th hats — fast, heavy, industrial.

tracks.name: ACID JAZZ NIGHT REMIX
tracks.vibe: Mellow, groovy acid jazz / nu-jazz night groove — warm Rhodes-like pads, syncopated swing feel, muted-brass square lead over a steady walking bass, mid-tempo and smooth.

tracks.name: GRAVE PUNK REMIX
tracks.vibe: E-minor punk at 168 BPM — fast, aggressive, headbanging; driving 8th-note sawtooth bass, square-wave lead with a rising hook into a full-speed riff climax, drums stacking to busy 16th hats.

tracks.name: CRYPT WALTZ REMIX
tracks.vibe: Slow E-minor gothic dirge waltz; deep triangle bass on downbeats, mournful vibrato square lead, sparse building funeral-kick drums — dark, atmospheric bat-cave energy.

tracks.name: CELTIC PIRATES REMIX
tracks.vibe: Fast, intense 8-bit pirate run-and-gun — storm-tossed tilting deck, thunder on the downbeat, cannon fire between phrases, ominous brass cutting through wind, maximum action pressure.

tracks.name: STORM AT SEA REMIX
tracks.vibe: Dark A-minor storm dirge at 84 BPM — deep slow triangle bass, mournful descending square lead with vibrato, sparse funeral drums swelling into a rolling sea, ominous chiptune voyage.

tracks.name: MARCH TO POWER REMIX
tracks.vibe: A-major military march at 120 BPM — heavy downbeat triangle bass boom-chick cadence, bold square lead rising fanfare hook into a full brass-style climax, drums building to marching sixteenths.

tracks.name: THE DECREE REMIX
tracks.vibe: Cold A-minor imperial anthem at 90 BPM — deep sub-bass, sparse commanding lead with long held notes and wide pauses, ceremonial drums swelling to a roll; monumental throne-room gravity for the boss reveal.

tracks.name: PHARAOH FURY v1 REMIX
tracks.vibe: Egyptian 8-bit drum-and-bass boss track — bad-ass, aggressive chiptune with punchy square-wave lead and heavy rolling DnB drums at a furious 174 BPM.

tracks.name: BLOOM OF THE DAMNED v1 REMIX
tracks.vibe: Epic 8-bit metal boss — heavy, slow, massive; 132 BPM half-time weight, sparse hammer-stab power chords, walking-root saw bass, chugging pads, deep punchy kick, dark E-minor doom.

tracks.name: Boss Stomp v5 REMIX
tracks.vibe: 8-bit chiptune boss theme — not melodic but rhythmic menace; heavy pounding, low growling sawtooth bass, staccato square-wave hits landing like punches, fist-like drums, fast aggressive punk energy at 180 BPM.

tracks.name: PETAL PANIC TITLE - EPIQUE
tracks.vibe: Epic, memorable 8-bit chiptune title theme — warm singing square-wave lead over a hummable A-major arpeggio hook, punchy sawtooth bass, wide epic pads, triumphant pop-minor progression building to a joyful peak.

tracks.name: TROPIC FIGHT ON DOCTOR ISLAND
tracks.vibe: Jazz-funk beat-and-bump at 104 BPM — groovy head-nod groove in Dorian b7 (Bb9), syncopated triangle bass with passing chromatics, muted-hat funk ghosting, wah-ish singing square lead, tropical fight energy.

tracks.name: TROPIC FIGHT 2 - THE TOWER ASCENSION
tracks.vibe: Catchy rock-metal-punk chiptune at 172 BPM — syncopated hook with a flat-6 wrong note that never resolves, epic Am-F-G-E minor circle, driving drums and octave-jump peaks.

tracks.name: TROPIC FIGHT 3 - DESCENT TO THE SEWER PASSAGE
tracks.vibe: Fast 172 BPM punk-metal chiptune in E major — square-wave lead with biting syncopation, punchy sawtooth bass, escalating drums, catchy falling melody that sinks into a low-register sewer dump.

tracks.name: PHARAOH'S WRATH
tracks.vibe: Aggressive Egyptian punk metal — fast 180 BPM, E harmonic minor, staccato 3-note hook over chugging eighth-note sawtooth bass with an angular square/saw lead and full pounding punk drums; heavy, raw, simple.

tracks.name: TOMB OF THE DAMNED
tracks.vibe: Heavy D-minor thrash at 174 BPM — galloping triplet sawtooth bass, low growling lead with deep vibrato, thick dark pads, full punk drums; slower, heavier, menacing than its siblings.

tracks.name: SCARAB STOMP
tracks.vibe: Pure speed punk, 184 BPM A minor; relentless square-wave root chug, one-note chant lead breaking into a fast riff, busiest drums, no pads until peak — fastest, thinnest, rawest of the set.

tracks.name: ANUBIS RAGE
tracks.vibe: Mid-tempo heavy Egyptian punk-metal breakdown in B minor — groovy walking bass, a singable square-wave lead that actually sings, warm sawtooth pads, full punchy drums; heavier and more dynamic than its frantic siblings.

tracks.name: Circus Balloon Drift
tracks.vibe: Chill, mellow lo-fi hip hop for a circus platformer — soft boom-bap drums, warm triangle/sine bass and pads with long notes, lazy floating drift at 80 BPM.

tracks.name: PIERROT'S GRINDER
tracks.vibe: Aggressive, mechanical industrial chiptune for a circus platformer — harsh four-on-the-floor kick, sawtooth bass/lead/pads with high cuts and short punchy notes, driving 130 BPM A-minor menace.

tracks.name: Big Top Skank
tracks.vibe: Laid-back offbeat reggae skank for a circus platformer — breezy, mellow, warm major/minor seventh chords, melodic walking triangle bass, sine pads, gentle one-drop groove with space.

tracks.name: BAROQUE BIGTOP
tracks.vibe: Ornate harpsichord-style Baroque circus theme — contrapuntal square-wave leads with melodic runs over a ground-bass ostinato and rich figured-bass chords, sparse lute-pluck drums, elegant and ceremonial at 100 BPM.

tracks.name: BIG TOP RUMBLE
tracks.vibe: Heavy dubstep with slow wobble sawtooth bass and half-time snare on beat three, dark atmospheric melody over sustained pads, ominous rumbling circus energy at 140 BPM.

tracks.name: Carnaval do Circo
tracks.vibe: Smooth bossa nova Brazilian swing for a circus platformer — lazy surdo kick, soft shaker hats, gentle walking bass, lyrical sine lead over lush warm maj7/min9 pads.

tracks.name: CIRCUS OF STATIC
tracks.vibe: Driving repetitive club techno at 135 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick with busy 16th hats, steady pulsing sawtooth root bass, minimal hypnotic square-wave hook over dark sustained pads — cold, mechanical, relentless.

tracks.name: TENTHOOD JIG
tracks.vibe: Fast Celtic folk jig/reel for a circus platformer — lively fiddle-tune lead, bodhran soft kick and light shaker, open-fifth drone pads, bright bouncy energy at 120 BPM.

tracks.name: CIRCUIT BIGTOP
tracks.vibe: Electric jazz fusion groove — complex syncopated ghost-note drums, chromatic walking bass, sophisticated improvisatory melody over lush extended 9th/13th chords, sawtooth guitar-ish lead, mid-tempo.

tracks.name: The Hollow Ring
tracks.vibe: Creepy horror-ambient drone at a slow 58 BPM — sparse distant thuds and cymbal wash, deep sine drones, eerie dissonant floating notes over minor-second and tritone clusters, unsettling whispering counter-melody.

tracks.name: Pirate Ship Reel
tracks.vibe: Lively Celtic folk jig/reel, fiddle-tune triangle lead over open-fifth sine pads, bodhran soft kick and light shaker with a steady 8th-note root/fifth bass groove — bright D-major circus energy at 120 BPM.

tracks.name: Tent Acid Trip
tracks.vibe: Psychedelic rock for a circus platformer — fuzzy, swirling, odd-time feel at 95 BPM; high-vibrato sawtooth lead bending between notes over lurching fuzzy bass and warm swirly pads in C minor.

tracks.name: Carousel Disco
tracks.vibe: Bright four-on-floor disco dance groove — funky syncopated sawtooth bass, catchy square-wave arpeggio hook, offbeat open hats, string-stab layers, upbeat cheerful major-key energy.

tracks.name: Midnight Big Top
tracks.vibe: Moody gothic darkwave at 100 BPM — melancholic soaring square-wave lead over dark sustained sawtooth minor pads and a sparse driving beat.

tracks.name: Sawdust Breaks
tracks.vibe: Breakbeat/electro at 125 BPM in C minor — sampled-drum feel with busy 16th hats and ghost snares, punchy square-wave electro bass stabs, angular electro lead riff, minimal sawtooth pads, high-energy circus-platformer groove.

tracks.name: Circus Requiem
tracks.vibe: Minimal neoclassical, slow and emotional at 70 BPM — sparse heartbeat pulse, deep roots, arpeggiated piano-like sine melody over lush sustained chords.

tracks.name: Ratchet Shred
tracks.vibe: Blazing speed-metal shred for a circus platformer — galloping eighth-note sawtooth bass, fast high-vibrato shredding leads, double-blast kick drums with 16th hats, dark minimal pads, E-minor frenzy.

tracks.name: Carrot Soul
tracks.vibe: Warm, groovy soul-funk groove for a circus platformer — deep melodic funk bass, soulful call-and-response leads, tight pocket drums with ghost notes, lush extended-chord pads.

tracks.name: Carnival Breeze
tracks.vibe: Laid-back sunny tropical house, ~100 BPM; soft four-on-floor kick with shaker hats, round sub-bass, breezy pentatonic triangle lead over warm sine major pads and marimba-like plucks.
